svg.title: Pagerless reference architecture
svg.desc: Operators use kubectl page or the React dashboard to reach the Go server. The server authenticates the request, records the transcript in SQLite, and calls the private Python, FastAPI and LangGraph agent, which uses an OpenAI-compatible Claude Haiku endpoint. Tool calls return through the server to the read-only MCP integrations for Kubernetes, GitHub, Prometheus and Grafana. The publisher opens a draft pull request with a separate write token. Observability alerts reach the MCP trigger at /mcp.
svg.text: Open-source AI SRE agent for Kubernetes · read-only investigation, cited evidence, draft pull requests
operator token · no credential in history
get · list · watch events · bounded logs
1 request · 2 turn + tool callbacks · 6 cited answer and evidence
